translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai .
yeh kitab Allah ki taraf say nazil ki jarahi hai , jo baray iqtidar ka malik hai , boht hikmat wala .
. ( aey payghumber ! ) beyshak yeh kitab hum ney tum per bar-haq nazil ki hai , iss liye Allah ki iss tarah ibadat kero kay bandagi khalis ussi kay liye ho .

yaad rakho kay khalis bandagi Allah hi ka haq hai . aur jinn logon  ney uss kay bajaye doosray rakhwalay bana liye hain ( yeh keh ker kay : )  hum inn ki ibadat sirf iss liye kertay hain kay yeh hamen Allah say qareeb kerden   unn kay darmiyan Allah unn baaton ka faisla keray ga jinn mein woh ikhtilaf ker rahey hain . yaqeen rakho kay Allah kissi aesay shaks ko raastay per nahi lata jo jhoota ho , kufr per jama huwa ho .

agar Allah yeh chahta kay kissi ko aulad banaye to woh apni makhlooq mein say jiss ko chahta muntakhib kerleta , ( lekin ) woh pak hai ( iss baat say kay uss ki koi aulad ho ) woh to Allah hai , aik , aur zabardast iqtidar ka malik !

uss ney saray aasman aur zameen bar-haq peda kiye hain . woh raat ko din per lapet deta hai , aur din ko raat per lapet deta hai , aur uss ney sooraj aur chaand ko kaam per lagaya huwa hai . her aik kissi moyyan mauddat tak kay liye rawan dawan hai . yaad rakho woh baray iqtidar ka malik , boht bakhshney wala hai .

uss ney tum sabb ko aik shaks say peda kiya ,   phir ussi say uss ka jorra banaya , aur tumharay liye maweshiyon mein say aath jooray peda kiye .   woh tumhari takhleeq tumhari maon kay pet mein iss tarah kerta hai kay teen andheriyon kay darmiyan tum banawat kay aik marhalay kay baad doosray marhalay say guzartay ho .   woh hai Allah jo tumhara perwerdigar hai ! sari badshahi ussi ki hai , uss kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi hai . phir bhi tumhara mun aakhir koi kahan say morr deta hai-?

agar tum kufr ikhtiyar kero gay to yaqeen rakho kay Allah tum say bey niaz hai , aur woh apney bandon kay liye kufr pasand nahi kerta , aur agar tum shukar kero gay to woh ussay tumharay liye pasand keray ga , aur koi bojh uthaney wala kissi doosray ka bojh nahi uthaye ga . phir tum sabb ko apney perwerdigar hi kay paas loat ker jana hai , uss waqt woh tumhen bataye ga kay tum kiya kuch kiya kertay thay . yaqeenan woh dilon ki baaten bhi khoob janta hai .

aur jab insan ko koi takleef choo jati hai to woh apney perwerdigar ko ussi say lo laga ker pukarta hai , phir jab woh insan ko apni taraf say koi naimat bakhsh deta hai to woh uss ( takleef ) ko bhool jata hai jiss kay liye pehlay Allah ko pukar raha tha , aur Allah kay liye shareek gharr leta hai , jiss kay nateejay mein doosron ko bhi Allah kay raastay say bhatkata hai . keh do kay :  kuch din apney kufr kay mazay uraley , yaqeenan tu dozakh walon mein shamil hai .

bhala ( kiya aisa shaks uss kay barabar hosakta hai ) jo raat ki gharriyon mein ibadat kerta hai , kabhi sajday mein , kabhi qayam mein , aakhirat say darta hai , aur apney perwerdigar ki rehmat ka umeedwaar hai-? kaho kay :  kiya woh jo jantay hain , aur jo nahi jantay , sabb barabar hain-?    ( magar ) naseehat to wohi log qubool kertay hain jo aqal walay hain .

keh do kay :  aey meray emaan walay bando ! apney perwerdigar ka khof dil mein rakho . bhalai unhi ki hai jinhon ney iss duniya mein bhalai ki hai , aur Allah ki zameen boht wasee hai ,   jo log sabar say kaam letay hain , unn ka sawab unhen bey hisab diya jaye ga .
keh do kay :  mujhay to hukum diya gaya hai kay mein Allah ki iss tarah ibadat kerun kay meri bandagi khalis ussi kay liye ho ,
aur mujhay hukum diya gaya hai kay sabb say pehla farmanbardaar mein banun .
keh do kay :  agar mein apney perwerdigar ki nafarmani kerun to mujhay aik zabardast din kay azab ka andesha hai .
keh do kay :  mein to Allah ki ibadat iss tarah kerta hun kay mein ney apni bandagi sirf ussi kay liye khalis kerli hai .

abb tum ussay chorr ker jiss ki chahao , ibadat kero .    keh do kay :  ghatay ka soda kernay walay to woh hain jo qayamat kay din apni janon aur apney ghar walon sabb ko hara bethen gay . yaad rakho kay khula huwa ghaata yehi hai .

aesay logon  kay liye unn kay oopper bhi aag kay badal hain , aur unn kay neechay bhi wesay hi badal . yeh wohi cheez hai jiss say Allah apney bandon ko darata hai . lehaza aey meray bando ! mera khof dil mein rakho .

aur jinn logon  ney iss baat say perhez kiya hai kay woh taghoot ki ibadat kernay lagen ,   aur unhon ney Allah say lo lagai hai , khushi ki khabar unhi kay liye hai , lehaza meray unn bandon ko khushi ki khabar suna do
jo baat ko ghor say suntay hain to uss mein jo behtareen hoti hai , uss ki perwi kertay hain .   yehi woh log hain jinhen Allah ney hidayat di hai , aur yehi hain jo aqal walay hain .
bhala jiss shaks per azab ki baat tey hochuki , to kiya tum ussay bacha lo gay jo aag kay andar phonch chuka hai ?

albatta jinhon ney apney perwerdigar ka khof dil mein rakha hai , unn kay liye oopper talay bani hoi oonchi oonchi imaraten hain , jinn kay neechay nehren behti hain . yeh Allah ka wada hai . Allah kabhi waday ki khilaf warzi nahi kerta .

kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay Allah ney aasman say paani utaara , phir ussay zameen kay sooton mein piro diya-?   phir woh uss paani say aesi khetiyan wajood mein lata hai jinn kay rang mukhtalif hain , phir woh khetiyan sookh jati hain to tum unhen dekhtay ho kay peeli parr-gai hain , phir woh unhen choora choora ker deta hai . yaqeenan inn baaton mein unn logon  kay liye bara sabaq hai jo aqal rakhtay hain .

bhala kiya woh shaks jiss ka seena Allah ney Islam kay liye khol diya hai , jiss kay nateejay mein woh apney perwerdigar ki ata ki hoi roshni mein aa-chuka hai , ( sang dilon kay barabar hosakta hai ? ) haan ! barbadi unn ki hai jinn kay dil Allah kay ziker say sakht hochukay hain . yeh log khuli gumrahi mein parray huye hain .

Allah ney behtareen kalam nazil farmaya hai , aik aesi kitab jiss kay mazameen aik doosray say miltay jultay hain , jiss ki baaten baar baar dohrai gaee hain . woh log jinn kay dilon mein apney perwerdigar ka roab hai inn/unn ki khalen iss say kaanp uthti hain , phir unn kay jism aur unn kay dil naram ho ker Allah ki yaad ki taraf mutawajjah hojatay hain . yeh Allah ki hidayat hai jiss kay zariye woh jiss ko chahta hai , raah-e-raast per ley aata hai , aur jissay Allah raastay say bhatka dey , ussay koi raastay per laney wala nahi .

bhala ( uss shaks ka kaisa bura haal hoga ) jo qayamat kay din apney chehray hi say bad-tareen azab ko rokna chahye ga-?   aur zalimon say kaha jaye ga kay :  chakho maza uss kamai ka jo tum ney ker rakhi thi .
jo log inn say pehlay thay , unhon ney bhi ( payghumberon ko ) jhutlaya tha jiss kay nateejay mein unn per azab aesi jagah say aaya jiss ki taraf unn ka gumaan bhi nahi jasakta tha ,
chunacheh Allah ney unn ko issi dunyawi zindagi mein ruswai ka maza chakhaya , aur aakhirat ka azab to aur bhi bara hai . kaash yeh log jantay !
haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney iss Quran mein logon  ki khatir her qisam ki misalen biyan ki hain , takay log sabaq hasil keren ,
yeh arbi Quran jiss mein koi tairrah nahi ! takay log taqwa ikhtiyar keren .

Allah ney aik misal yeh di hai kay aik ( ghulam ) shaks hai jiss ki milkiyat mein kaee log shareek hain jinn kay darmiyan aapas mein kheench taan bhi hai , aur doosra ( ghulam ) shaks woh hai jo pooray ka poora aik hi aadmi ki milkiyat hai . kiya inn dono ki halat aik jaisi hosakti hai-?   Alhamdulillah ! ( iss misal say baat bilkul wazeh hogaee ) lekin inn mein say aksar log samajhtay nahi .
. ( aey payghumber ! ) moat tumhen bhi aani hai , aur moat unhen bhi aani hai ,
phir tum sabb qayamat kay din apney perwerdigar kay paas apna muqadma paish kero gay .
abb batao kay uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo Allah per jhoot baandhay , aur jab sachi baat uss kay paas aaye to woh uss ko jhutla dey-? kiya jahannum mein aesay kafiron ka thikana nahi hoga-?
aur jo log sachi baat ley ker ayen , aur khud bhi ussay sach maanen woh hain jo muttaqi hain .
unn ko apney perwerdigar kay paas her woh cheez milay gi jo woh chahen gay . yeh hai naik logon  ka badla ,
takay unhon ney jo bad-tareen kaam kiye thay , Allah unn ka kaffara kerday , aur jo behtareen kaam kertay rahey thay , unn ka sawab unhen ata farmaye .

. ( aey payghumber ! ) kiya Allah apney banday kay liye kafi nahi hai-? aur yeh log tumhen uss kay siwa doosron say daratay hain , aur jissay Allah raastay say bhatka dey , ussay koi raastay per laney wala nahi ,
aur jissay Allah raah-e-raast per ley aaye , ussay koi raastay say bhatkaney wala nahi . kiya Allah zabardast , intiqam lenay wala nahi-?

aur agar tum inn say poocho kay aasmano ko aur zameen ko kiss ney peda kiya hai-? to woh zaroor yehi kahen gay kay Allah ney . ( unn say ) kaho kay : " zara mujhay yeh batao kay tum Allah ko chorr ker jinn ( button ) ko pukartay ho , agar Allah mujhay koi nuqsan phonchaney ka irada kerlay to kiya yeh uss kay phonchaye huye nuqsan ko door ker-saktay hain-? ya agar Allah mujh per meharbani farmana chahye to kiya yeh uss ki rehmat ko rok saktay hain-?   kaho kay : " meray liye Allah hi kafi hai . bharosa rakhney walay ussi per bharosa rakhtay hain .
keh do kay : " aey meri qoam kay logo ! tum apney tareeqay per amal kiye jao , mein ( apney tareeqay per ) amal ker raha hun , phir unqareeb tumhen pata chal jaye ga
kay kiss per woh azab aata hai jo ussay ruswa ker kay rakh dey ga , aur kiss per woh azab nazil hota hai jo hamesha jamm ker rahey ga .

. ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney logon  kay faeeday kay liye tum per yeh kitab bar-haq nazil ki hai . abb jo shaks raah-e-raast per aajaye ga , woh apni hi bhalai kay liye aaye ga , aur jo gumrahi ikhtiyar keray ga , woh apni gumrahi say apna hi nuqsan keray ga , aur tum uss kay zimma daar nahi ho .

Allah tamam roohon ko unn ki moat kay waqt qabz kerleta hai , aur jinn ko abhi moat nahi aai hoti , unn ko bhi unn ki neend ki halat mein ( qabz kerleta hai , ) phir jinn kay baaray mein uss ney moat ka faisla kerliya , unhen apney paas rok leta hai , aur doosri roohon ko aik moyyan waqt tak kay liye chorr deta hai .   yaqeenan iss baat mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo ghor o fiker say kaam letay hain .

bhala kiya inn logon  ney Allah ( ki ijazat ) kay baghair kuch sirfarishi gharr rakhay hain-? ( inn say ) kaho kay :  chahye yeh naa koi ikhtiyar rakhtay hon , naa kuch samajhtay hon ( phir bhi tum unhen sirfarishi mantay raho gay-? )
kaho kay : " sifarish to sari ki sari Allah hi kay ikhtiyar mein hai . ussi kay qabazay mein aasmano aur zameen ki badshahi hai , phir ussi ki taraf tumhen lotaya jaye ga .

aur jab kabhi tanha Allah ka ziker kiya jata hai to jo log aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay , unn kay dil beyzar hojatay hain , aur jab uss kay siwa doosron ka ziker kiya jata hai to yeh log khushi say khil uthtay hain .

kaho : " aey Allah ! aey aasmano aur zameen ko peda kernay walay , her ghaeeb o hazir kay janney walay ! tu hi apney bandon kay darmiyan unn baaton ka faisla keray ga jinn mein woh ikhtilaf kertay rahey hain .

aur jinn logon  ney zulm ka irtikab kiya hai , agar unn kay paas woh sabb kuch ho jo zameen mein hai , aur uss kay sath itna hi aur bhi , to qayamat kay din badd tareen azab say bachnay kay liye woh sabb fidya kay tor per denay lagen gay , aur Allah ki taraf say woh kuch unn kay samney aajaye ga jiss ka unhen gumaan bhi nahi tha ,
unhon ney jo kamai ki thi , uss ki buraiyan unn kay samney zahir hojayen gi , aur jinn baaton ka woh mazaq uraya kertay thay , woh unhen chaaron taraf say gher len gi .

phir   insan ( ka haal yeh hai kay jab uss ) ko koi takleef choo jati hai to woh hamen pukarta hai , uss kay baad jab hum ussay apni taraf say kissi naimat say nawaztay hain to woh kehta hai kay : " yeh to mujhay ( apney ) hunar ki wajeh say mili hai .   nahi ! balkay yeh aazmaesh hai , lekin inn mein say aksar log nahi jantay .
yehi baat inn say pehlay ( kuch ) logon  ney bhi kahi thi ,   nateeja yeh huwa kay jo kuch woh kamatay thay , woh unn kay kaam nahi aaya ,

aur unhon ney jo kamai ki thi , uss ki buraiyan unhi per aa parren , aur inn ( arab kay ) logon  mein say jinhon ney zulm ka irtikab kiya hai , unn ki kamai ki buraiyan bhi unqareeb unn per aa parren gi , aur yeh ( Allah ) ko aajiz nahi ker-saktay .

aur kiya enhen yeh maloom nahi hai kay Allah jiss kay liye chahta hai , rizq mein wusat ker deta hai , aur wohi tangi bhi ker deta hai-? yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo emaan latay hain .

keh do kay : " aey meray woh bando ! jinhon ney apni janon per ziyadti ker rakhi hai , Allah ki rehmat say mayyus naa ho . yaqeen jano Allah saray kay saray gunah moaaf ker deta hai .   yaqeenan woh boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
aur tum apney perwerdigar say lo lagao , aur uss kay farmanbardar ban jao qabal iss kay kay tumharay paas azab aa phonchay , phir tumhari madad nahi ki jaye gi .
aur tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say tumharay paas jo behtareen baaten nazil ki gaee hain , unn ki perwi kero , qabal iss kay kay tum per achanak azab aajaye , aur tumhen pata bhi naa chalay ,

kahen aisa naa ho kay kissi shaks ko yeh kehna parray kay : " haaye afsos meri uss kotahi per jo mein ney Allah kay moamlay mein barti ! aur sachi baat yeh hai kay mein to ( Allah taalaa kay ehkaam ka ) mazaq uraney walon mein shamil hogaya tha .
ya koi yeh kahey kay :  agar mujhay Allah hidayat deta to mein bhi muttaqi logon  mein shamil hota .
ya jab azab aankhon say dekh ley to yeh kahey kay : " kaash mujhay aik martaba wapis janey ka moaqa mil jaye to mein naik logon  mein shamil hojaon !
. ( tujhay hidayat ) kiyon nahi ( di gaee-? ) meri aayaten teray paas aa-chuki then , phir tu ney unhen jhutlaya , aur barai kay ghamand mein parr-gaya , aur kafiron mein shamil raha .
aur qayamat kay din tum dekho gay kay jinn logon  ney Allah per jhoot baandha hai , unn kay chehray siyah parray huye hain . kiya jahannum mein aesay mutakabbiron ka thikana nahi hoga-?
aur jinn logon  ney taqwa ikhtiyar kiya hai , Allah unn ko nijat dey ker unn ki murad ko phoncha dey ga , unhen koi takleef chooay gi bhi nahi , aur naa unhen kissi baat ka ghum hoga .
Allah her cheez ka peda kernay wala hai , aur wohi her cheez ka rakhwala hai .
saray aasmano aur zameen ki kunjiyan ussi kay paas hain , aur jinhon ney Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kiya hai ghatay mein rehney walay wohi hain .
keh do kay :  kiya phir bhi aey jahilo ! tum mujh say kehtay ho kay Allah kay siwa kissi aur ki ibadat kerun-?

aur yeh haqeeqat hai kay tum say aur tum say pehlay tamam payghumberon say wahi kay zariye yeh baat keh di gaee thi kay agar tum ney shirk ka irtikab kiya to tumhara kiya keraya sabb gharat hojaye ga , aur tum yaqeeni tor per sakht nuqsan uthaney walon mein shamil hojao gay .
lehaza uss kay bajaye tum Allah hi ki ibadat kero , aur shukar guzaar logon  mein shamil hojao .

aur inn logon  ney Allah taalaa ki qadar hi nahi pehchani jaisa kay uss ki qadar pehchanney ka haq tha , halankay poori ki poori zameen qayamat kay din uss ki mutthi mein hogi , aur saray kay saray aasman uss kay dayen haath mein liptay huye hon gay . woh pak hai , aur boht baala o bartar uss shirk say jiss ka irtikab yeh log ker rahey hain .

aur soor phoonka jaye ga to aasmano aur zameen mein jitney hain , woh sabb bey hosh hojayen gay , siwaye uss kay jissay Allah chahye . phir doosri baar phoonka jaye ga to woh sabb log pal bhar mein kharray ho ker dekhney lagen gay .

aur zameen apney perwerdigar kay noor say chamak uthay gi , aur nama aemal samney rakh diya jaye ga , aur anbiya aur sabb gawahon ko hazir kerdiya jaye ga , aur logon  kay darmiyan bilkul bar-haq faisla kiya jaye ga , aur unn per koi zulm nahi hoga .
aur her shaks ko uss kay amal ka poora poora badla diya jaye ga , aur jo kuch log kertay hain , Allah ussay khoob janta hai .

aur jinn logon  ney kufr apnaya tha , unhen jahannum ki taraf girohon ki shakal mein haanka jaye ga , yahan tak kay jab woh uss kay paas phonch jayen gay to uss kay darwazay kholay jayen gay , aur uss kay mohafiz unn say kahen gay kay :  kiya tumharay paas tumharay apney logon  mein say payghumber nahi aaye thay jo tumhen tumharay rab ki aayaten parh ker sunatay hon , aur tumhen iss din ka samna kernay say khabar daar kertay hon-?  woh kahen gay kay :  beyshak aaye thay , lekin azab ki baat kafiron per sachi ho ker rahi .
kaha jaye ga kay :  jahannum kay darwazon mein hamesha hamesha rehney kay liye dakhil hojao , kiyonkay boht bura thikana hai unn ka jo takabbur say kaam letay hain .

aur jinhon ney apney perwerdigar say taqwa ka moamla rakha tha unhen jannat ki taraf girohon ki shakal mein ley jaya jaye ga , yahan tak kay jab woh uss kay paas phonchen gay , jabkay uss kay darwazay unn kay liye pehlay say kholay jaa chukay hon gay , ( to woh ajeeb aalam hoga . ) aur uss kay mohafiz unn say kahen gay kay :  salam ho aap per , khoob rahey aap log ! abb iss jannat mein hamesha hamesha rehney kay liye aa jaiye .

aur woh ( jannati ) kahen gay kay :  tamam tarr shukar Allah ka hai jiss ney hum say apney waday ko sacha ker dikhaya , aur hamen iss sarzameen ka aisa waris bana diya kay hum jannat mein jahan chahen apna thikana bana len . sabit huwa kay behtareen inaam ( naik ) amal kernay walon ka hai .

aur tum farishton ko dekho gay kay arsh kay gird halqa banaye huye apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath uss ki tasbeeh ker rahey hon gay , aur logon  kay darmiyan bar-haq faisla kerdiya jaye ga , aur kehney walay kahen gay kay :  tamam tarr tareef Allah ki hai jo saray jahano ka perwerdigar hai .
